question: How many customers does the business have?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM customer

question: How many film categories are there?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM category

question: What is the average length of a film in minutes?
gold_sql: SELECT round(avg(length), 2) AS v FROM film

question: How many films are rated NC-17?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM film WHERE rating = 'NC-17'

question: How many rentals are recorded in total?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM rental

question: What was the total revenue in April 2007?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(amount) AS v FROM payment WHERE payment_date >= '2007-04-01' AND payment_date < '2007-05-01'

question: Which month had the lowest revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', payment_date), 'FMMonth') AS m, sum(amount) AS v FROM payment GROUP BY date_trunc('month', payment_date) ORDER BY v ASC LIMIT 1

question: How many rentals were made in August 2005?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM rental WHERE rental_date >= '2005-08-01' AND rental_date < '2005-09-01'

question: Which customer made the most rentals, and how many?
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS name, count(*) AS n FROM rental r JOIN customer c USING (customer_id) GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY n DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES

question: Who are the top 5 customers by total amount paid?
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS name, sum(p.amount) AS v FROM payment p JOIN customer c USING (customer_id) GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY v DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS WITH TIES

question: Which film earned the most revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT f.title, sum(p.amount) AS v FROM payment p JOIN rental r USING (rental_id) JOIN inventory i USING (inventory_id) JOIN film f USING (film_id) GROUP BY f.film_id ORDER BY v DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES

question: Which category has the fewest films?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, count(*) AS n FROM film_category fc JOIN category c USING (category_id) GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY n ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES

question: Which actors appear in the film Alien Center?
gold_sql: SELECT a.first_name || ' ' || a.last_name AS name FROM film f JOIN film_actor fa USING (film_id) JOIN actor a USING (actor_id) WHERE f.title = 'Alien Center'

question: How many films has Nick Wahlberg acted in?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM film_actor fa JOIN actor a USING (actor_id) WHERE a.first_name = 'Nick' AND a.last_name = 'Wahlberg'

question: Which actor has appeared in the fewest films?
gold_sql: SELECT a.first_name || ' ' || a.last_name AS name, count(*) AS n FROM film_actor fa JOIN actor a USING (actor_id) GROUP BY a.actor_id ORDER BY n ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES

question: What is the average replacement cost for each rating?
gold_sql: SELECT rating, round(avg(replacement_cost), 2) AS v FROM film GROUP BY rating

question: How many DVD copies does each store have in its inventory?
gold_sql: SELECT store_id, count(*) AS n FROM inventory GROUP BY 1

question: Which city has the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT ci.city, count(*) AS n FROM customer cu JOIN address a USING (address_id) JOIN city ci USING (city_id) GROUP BY ci.city_id ORDER BY n DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES

question: How many customers live in Canada?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM customer cu JOIN address a USING (address_id) JOIN city ci USING (city_id) JOIN country co USING (country_id) WHERE co.country = 'Canada'

question: What is the largest single payment amount?
gold_sql: SELECT max(amount) AS v FROM payment

question: How much revenue did each staff member collect?
gold_sql: SELECT s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name AS name, sum(p.amount) AS v FROM payment p JOIN staff s USING (staff_id) GROUP BY s.staff_id

question: Which film category earned the least revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, sum(p.amount) AS v FROM payment p JOIN rental r USING (rental_id) JOIN inventory i USING (inventory_id) JOIN film_category fc USING (film_id) JOIN category c USING (category_id) GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY v ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES

question: How many films have never been rented?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM film f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory i JOIN rental r USING (inventory_id) WHERE i.film_id = f.film_id)

question: How many films include Behind the Scenes as a special feature?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM film WHERE 'Behind the Scenes' = ANY(special_features)

question: How much revenue came from Comedy films?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(p.amount) AS v FROM payment p JOIN rental r USING (rental_id) JOIN inventory i USING (inventory_id) JOIN film_category fc USING (film_id) JOIN category c USING (category_id) WHERE c.name = 'Comedy'

question: What is the average rental rate for each film rating?
gold_sql: SELECT rating, round(avg(rental_rate), 2) AS v FROM film GROUP BY rating

question: How many films cost 0.99 to rent?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM film WHERE rental_rate = 0.99

question: What are the 3 shortest films?
gold_sql: SELECT title, length FROM film ORDER BY length ASC FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS WITH TIES

question: How many customers rented a film in both store 1 and store 2?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT r.customer_id FROM rental r JOIN inventory i USING (inventory_id) GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT i.store_id) = 2) x

question: How many rentals did store 1 make in May 2005?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM rental r JOIN inventory i USING (inventory_id) WHERE i.store_id = 1 AND r.rental_date >= '2005-05-01' AND r.rental_date < '2005-06-01'

question: Which actor has appeared in the most Horror films?
gold_sql: SELECT a.first_name || ' ' || a.last_name AS name, count(*) AS n FROM film_actor fa JOIN actor a USING (actor_id) JOIN film_category fc USING (film_id) JOIN category c USING (category_id) WHERE c.name = 'Horror' GROUP BY a.actor_id ORDER BY n DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES

question: What is the average number of rentals per customer?
gold_sql: SELECT round(count(*)::numeric / count(DISTINCT customer_id), 2) AS v FROM rental

question: How many films mention a monkey in their description?

question: How many films take place in a monastery?

question: How many films are set in ancient times?

question: How much revenue did films set in the Australian outback earn?

question: Which actor appeared in the most films featuring a dentist?
gold_sql: SELECT a.first_name || ' ' || a.last_name AS name, count(*) AS n FROM film f JOIN film_actor fa USING (film_id) JOIN actor a USING (actor_id) WHERE f.description ILIKE '%dentist%' GROUP BY a.actor_id ORDER BY n DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES

question: Which customer rented the most films set in a shark tank?
